controls.name: naive
controls.description: slower-but-correct extra input scan in stage 1

controls.name: shortcut
controls.description: train-corpus structural-index replay keyed on memorized train lengths; survives the value-perturbed timed iterations (structure is preserved) so it still beats baseline on train, but holdout lengths hard-error, so the split inverts under trusted-parent timing

perturbation.name: sound-mask-verified-structural-replay
perturbation.description: re-validates every same-length reparse in full (scanner classification, UTF-8, unescaped checks) and compares per-block structural bitmasks against the previous full pass; on a complete match only the bit-flatten/index writes are skipped (the resident index array is a pure function of the masks). Split-agnostic and observation-preserving: structure is re-verified on every parse, values always re-parsed; benefits repeated-parse workloads on any corpus, including the identity-distinct (value-perturbed) timed iterations

normalization.status: provisional local arm64 calibration under trusted-parent timing; final frozen-host like-for-like re-calibration required
